notice: All names, ages, balances, rates and transactions are invented. No personal or client record is used. The BTC price and tax provision are teaching assumptions, not current market data or tax advice. No projected retirement date, probability, payoff date or benefit quote is asserted.

cash_flow.morgan_convention: After ordinary business operating expenses, before the equipment-loan debt service modeled separately below; not business revenue and not a verified tax-return profit figure.
cash_flow.tax_provision_kind: Illustrative cash-flow provision, not engine-computed liability or a recommended withholding amount. Replace with approved calculation/verified inputs before numerical app capture.
cash_flow.living_convention: After income-tax provision and before required debt service and employee contributions; the categories are counted once.
cash_flow.employer_match_status: Fictional plan formula, separately deposited retirement benefit; not household spendable surplus.

accounts.basis_status: mixed known and unknown; no invented zero basis

accounts.menu: Fictional plan permits Traditional/Roth employee choices and a spot Bitcoin fund through a brokerage window; real plans must be verified.

accounts.job: Dedicated healthcare funds; excluded from this illustrative general allocation denominator, not lost from the balance sheet.
Dedicated education; actual account ownership and beneficiary form require exact setup at capture.
Residence. Gross value belongs in balance sheet. No unrestricted spending proceeds assumed without an explicit sale/financing model.

debts.payment_kind: fictional current required payment, not an amortization output

debts.collateral: vehicle; vehicle value excluded from the simplified asset fixture

debts.payment_kind: illustrative current minimum; not a permanent contractual minimum formula

debts.collateral: business equipment and possible guarantee; equipment/business value excluded from simplified asset fixture

stress.scope: Transparent partial stress. HSA/529 and omitted vehicle/business values are not fully stressed; not a comprehensive worst case.

target_example.status: Hypothetical comparison only; not approved household allocation or trade instruction

lot_example.fee_assumption: Fees excluded for arithmetic illustration, never imputed as known zero in real records

retirement_examples.notice: Examples only; subtracting gross income from spending is not the final tax/debt/event-adjusted portfolio draw. No real benefit estimate is claimed.

capture_requirements: Choose and verify the full loan terms, income/benefit assumptions, current tax calculations and event dates the engine requires.
Record approved app commit, fixture version, financial input hash, result receipt, account mode, and as-of time.
Use actual engine outputs. Do not assign an expected success rate, earliest age, payoff date, guardrail balance or college gap in advance.
Reconcile any app eligible-portfolio denominator difference from the deliberately scoped teaching denominator.
Label arithmetic-only graphics separately from model outputs and keep original/reduced-spending states separate.
